run_report_latest: run the benchpress report command to report the latest benchmark results for specified jobs
run_report_all: run the benchpress report command with --all flag to report all historical benchmark results
create_report_parser: create an argparse subparser for the benchpress report command with jobs and reporter arguments
report_job_metrics: report benchmark job metrics including run_id and timestamp using a configured reporter
load_historical_results: load historical benchmark results for a job using the History class and report them
